name: Town Judaism
description: Religious buildings boost the influence of your faction's religion both within and across your borders, and can also improve sanitation in your settlements. The type of religious building chain available within a region depends on state religion of the controlling faction.

variants.name: River Mikve
variants.short: Simplicity in natural water and purity in its cleansing power.
variants.flavour: A mikve is a bath created for the purpose of full-body immersion, as part of religious rituals. They were required, as part of their construction, to be attached to a natural water source, or any body of water with a natural spring as its source. Pure water is drawn through an aperture which allows it to fill the mikve's immersion pool. Purification was required after sexual acts, the treatment of skin conditions, or the passing of bodily fluids. The idea of purification through water remains prevalent as it was during antiquity; the Zoroastrian Sassanids, for instance, used their bathhouses for purification as well as general sanitation.

effects.text: Sanitation: +2 to all regions in this province (province to each region)
